name: WolfToxic -Ookami Otoko ni Ki o Tsukero-
original_name: WolfToxic-オオカミ男に気をつけろ-
source:
Suddenly thrust into the world of werewolves and vampires, you become the mate of one of these brutish men! 
You're a police officer assigned to one of the most bustling cities in the world; Tokyo. Underneath the vast near future metropolis, werewolves and vampires lurk in all corners of life. One faithful night plunges you into their world. Saved by the beautiful wolf men from a vampire who had his fangs in your neck, they are looking for a mate to continue their lineage - You!
The world of Wicked Wolves is a dangerous place and these boys come with a bite!
Who will you choose?

[From [url=https://www.facebook.com/WW-Wicked-Wolves-711794529168520/]Facebook[/url]]
translation:
你突然被推入狼人和吸血鬼的世界，成為其中一名粗野男人的伴侶！

你是一名警察，被派往世界上最繁忙的城市之一：東京。在這座龐大的近未來都市之下，狼人和吸血鬼潛伏在生活的每個角落。一個命運般的夜晚將你捲入他們的世界。你被一名美麗的狼族男子從咬住你脖子的吸血鬼手中救下，而他們正在尋找能夠延續血脈的伴侶——那個人就是你！

《邪惡狼人》的世界十分危險，而這些男孩會咬人！

你會選擇誰？

[來源：[url=https://www.facebook.com/WW-Wicked-Wolves-711794529168520/]Facebook[/url]]
